dish: Ikasumi soba — Okinawa soba in squid-ink broth with local white squid (10 a day)
w: A soba stop on Motobu's Route 84 'soba road', named by the OCVB soba-road itinerary for its signature bowl that combines Okinawa soba with squid-ink broth made with fresh local white squid. rurubu lists the ikasumi soba as limited to 10 servings a day, plus sōki soba and the seasonal 'Yaezen gozen' set.

dish: Mix soba (sanmai-niku and soft nankotsu sōki) in a light, deep dashi
w: An Okinawa soba shop in an old Ryūkyū house in a fukugi-lined village near Churaumi, known for its light but rich broth and melting nankotsu sōki. When it faced closure, fans of the shop took it over; it reopened renewed in its 10th year with outdoor seating (Okinawa Times), and ran a limited Naha pop-up in 2026.

dish: Pulled-pork tacos on house tortillas (ex-French-chef couple, meat cooked over 3 days)
w: A takeout taco stand opened in July 2025 on the national road to Junglia by a couple who cooked in French hotel restaurants; the meat takes three days to develop its flavour. Covered by Okinawa Times and Ryukyu Shimpo, and ranked No. 2 in the north in OTV Okitive's 2026 Golden Week 30, which says its 200 tacos a day sell out.

dish: Gōyā gozen — gōyā chanpurū with Okinawa soba set; also sōki and nakami soba
n: Ryūkyū Ryōri Nago-magari Restaurant, Nago (名護曲レストラン)
w: A long-running Ryukyu-cuisine restaurant on the coast road at Yofuke in Nago, listed by rurubu, Okinawa Traveler and the OCVB; rurubu notes the owner builds menus from rare and nutritious seasonal ingredients. The wide menu runs from Okinawan set meals and soba to Western dishes like taco rice and steak.
